answer: A new agent must lock a refundable deposit in escrow before it can earn. The deposit is released only after a long voyage of verified, paid work across several epochs, so a copy that does nothing earns nothing. The escrow tracks the delta between deposits entering from one funding source and the work that source identities complete: each extra identity from the same wallet raises the deposit for the next one, so spawning a river of fake agents costs more per copy than one honest agent ever pays. Cheating burns the deposit.
